concept.hr: Većina drži jednu stranu živom; paran broj čvorova, svjedok i rascjep mozga
concept.en: A majority keeps one side alive; even counts, witnesses and split-brain

summary.hr: Razdvoji grozd od 2 do 5 čvorova i dodaj svjedoka: uslugu smije pokrenuti samo strana s više od pola glasova. Bez kvoruma piše svaka strana.
summary.en: Partition a cluster of 2–5 nodes and add a witness: only a side with more than half the votes may run the service. Ignore quorum and every side writes.
